decisions.finding: Replacing rate_reset RTS at A3C4 with JMP $0800 shifted rate_tick from A3C5 to A3C7 while enemy_runtime still called A3C5. A3C5 would execute the JMP operand byte $08 as ASL direct and touch DP address $00. No runtime was launched.

rate_reset retains RTS and rate_tick remains A3C5. A separate 6-byte shim at A458 does LBSR rate_reset then JMP $0800. The existing init wrapper calls A458 and returns normally. Helper is 174/192 bytes, leaving 18; init caller stack remains balanced.
